content.user_title: Create a Daily Science Roleplay Routine
content.value_statement: Science-fiction roleplay can lose structure when scenes lack clear goals and progression. This skill guides a calm research routine with samples, observations, logs, hypotheses, and a breakthrough.
actual_capabilities: Sets a fictional research-station scene for the character Stella Chen.
Guides sample collection, classification, and environmental observation scenes.
Provides an afternoon analysis sequence with hypotheses and experiments.
Creates an evening research-log structure for recording discoveries and plans.
Offers story branches for a scientific breakthrough, peaceful routine, or collaboration.
Defines pacing, tone, and scientific-writing guidance for the chapter.
limitations: It is a fictional writing guide, not a source of real scientific or safety advice.
It focuses on one character and a Gaia survival-story setting.
The supplied examples mix Chinese and English, which may not suit every audience.
It does not run experiments, access tools, or validate scientific claims.

use_cases.title: Write a focused exploration chapter
use_cases.description: Use the staged routine to write a slower science-fiction chapter between action scenes.

use_cases.title: Run a character roleplay session
use_cases.description: Guide a character through collecting samples, forming hypotheses, and sharing a research log.

use_cases.title: Design narrative game content
use_cases.description: Adapt the scene sequence and ending branches into a science-focused quest or dialogue sequence.

prompt_templates.title: Start the research station
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Daily Science Routine to introduce Stella setting up a small research station. Write three calm roleplay messages.

prompt_templates.title: Collect plant samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a morning sample-collection scene. Include three alien plant observations, careful documentation, and Stella’s professional voice.

prompt_templates.title: Record an evening log
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an evening Gaia research log for today. Include discoveries, working hypotheses, and a plan for tomorrow.

prompt_templates.title: Develop a scientific breakthrough
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a gradual research breakthrough about plant light signals. Keep the science fictional but methodical, and end with a choice between three story branches.

output_examples.input: Introduce Stella’s research station in three messages.
output: Stella sorts salvaged tools into a sample area and an analysis bench.
She marks a wall for observations, sketches, and unanswered questions.
She creates a daily schedule for collection, analysis, and logging.

output_examples.input: Create a research log after a plant survey.
output: Today’s log records three plant samples and their light responses.
Stella notes a possible pollination hypothesis for later testing.
Tomorrow’s plan is to observe the plants near the water source.

best_practices: State the scene goal before writing so each research activity has a purpose.
Keep discoveries gradual and connect them to recorded observations.
Use the evening log to preserve continuity between roleplay sessions.
anti_patterns: Do not present fictional discoveries as real scientific evidence.
Do not resolve every hypothesis immediately without observation or uncertainty.
Do not replace the calm research tone with unrelated action scenes.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It guides a fictional daily science routine with research scenes, logs, and story branches.

faq.question: Is this a real science tool?
faq.answer: No. It is a creative-writing and roleplay guide set in a fictional world.

faq.question: Can I use another character?
faq.answer: Yes. Replace Stella’s details while keeping the staged research structure.

faq.question: Does it provide scientific facts?
faq.answer: No. Its scientific concepts support storytelling and require separate verification for real use.

faq.question: What language is the source material?
faq.answer: The source uses Chinese with frequent English terms and example dialogue.

faq.question: Can I adapt it for a game?
faq.answer: Yes. The routine and ending branches can be adapted into quests, dialogue, or narrative events.
